title: Myocardial Infarction-related Acute Mechanical ComplIcations: results from an international retrospective cohort study
summary: Die Studie ist zur Untersuchung der Behandlungsergebnisse, des Krankheitsverlaufes, und spezieller Risikofaktoren bei Patienten mit akuten infarkt-bedingten mechanischen Komplikationen konzipiert.
conditions: Ventricular septal defect as current complication following acute myocardial infarction
Rupture of cardiac wall without haemopericardium as current complication following acute myocardial infarction
Rupture of papillary muscle as current complication following acute myocardial infarction

interventions.name: This retrospective multi-center study is designed to investigate clinical endpoints and risk factors associated with poor outcomes among patients experiencing acute papillary muscle rupture, ventricular septal rupture, or ventricular free wall rupture related to acute myocardial infarction. In addit

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Papillary muscle rupture, ventricular septal rupture, or ventricular free wall rupture complicating acute myocardial infarction
Exclusion criteria:
Chronic myocardial infarction-related mechanical complications
